sections.title: Contemporary Issues in Mathematics Curriculum
sections.description: Educational leaders and policy makers in the U.S. have long used curriculum reform to drive change in K-12 teaching and schooling practices. This course examines the assumptions underlying this approach and examines the related research evidence.
